set.body: Scope: interview/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/interview/** (assess.scala, induce.scala, atoms.scala, scoring/Scoring.scala, atlas.scala, README) and the interview suites. Method: for each contract line in AGENTS.md §Design contract and the module README, find where it is enforced by type/law vs. merely asserted in prose; construct executable probes (a private archive export; sbt interviewJVM/test with added probe tests) that try to move a score by changing quantity, fluency, atomization, ordering, or duplication without changing evidence. Known instance already filed: bd-01M15B0E06VTENH4R7M4Z5Q172 (phenomenology detail-count-weighted) — do not duplicate it; find the others. Deliverable: one post on coordination with verdict + numbered findings (file:line, repro, proposed law), each routed to a proposed bead; under 600 words. No edits, no reservations, no sbt in shared checkouts.
set.title: interview: read-only adversarial review of scoring/profile/assess against the design contract (AGENTS.md contracts; phenomenology ≠ detail quantity; veridicality never inferred from fluency/quantity; every score traceable to addressed evidence) — findings routed to beads, no edits
